name: patient_has_finding_of_carotid_stenosis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has carotid stenosis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has carotid stenosis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have carotid stenosis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has carotid stenosis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_carotid_stenosis_now@@monolateral
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current carotid stenosis is monolateral (affecting only one side).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current carotid stenosis is monolateral (affecting only one side).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current carotid stenosis is not monolateral (i.e., bilateral or unspecified).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current carotid stenosis is monolateral.

name: patient_has_finding_of_carotid_stenosis_now@@significant
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current carotid stenosis is significant (meets the clinical threshold for significance).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current carotid stenosis is significant (meets the clinical threshold for significance).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current carotid stenosis is not significant.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current carotid stenosis is significant.

name: patient_has_finding_of_carotid_stenosis_now@@soft
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current carotid stenosis is soft (referring to the plaque composition or imaging characteristics).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current carotid stenosis is soft (referring to the plaque composition or imaging characteristics).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current carotid stenosis is not soft.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's current carotid stenosis is soft.

name: patient_has_finding_of_carotid_artery_occlusion_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has occlusion of the carotid artery.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of occlusion of the carotid artery.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of occlusion of the carotid artery.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has occlusion of the carotid artery.

name: patient_has_finding_of_carotid_artery_occlusion_now@@contralateral
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's carotid artery occlusion is contralateral.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's carotid artery occlusion is contralateral.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's carotid artery occlusion is not contralateral.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the carotid artery occlusion is contralateral.

name: patient_has_critical_stenosis_of_external_carotid_artery_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has critical stenosis of the external carotid artery.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has critical stenosis of the external carotid artery.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have critical stenosis of the external carotid artery.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has critical stenosis of the external carotid artery.
